requirements.text: Require an identity-matching legal Phase 40.7 BGP before exact reasoning.
Revalidate the resolved authorized SPARQL dataset against the immutable graph catalog.
Materialize the exact default or named BGP scoping graph with correct union-versus-merge blank-node behavior.
Enumerate a finite typed candidate space deterministically and fail closed above configured ceilings.
Partition candidate ordinals deterministically and execute bounded HermiT lanes without CPU oversubscription.
For every candidate, require the grounded target plus active ontology to remain OWL 2 DL.
Use HermiT isEntailed over grounded logical axioms and never promote partial execution.
Require gap-free partition completion and common candidate/reasoner identities before exact-complete result construction.
Emit a DirectBgpResult and DirectCertificate bound to query, dataset, authorization and semantic qualification hashes.
Fail closed for anonymous-individual instance-map semantics until independently qualified.
Expose the exact fallback through the checksum/path-confined reference-worker direct-bgp job mode.
Keep Phase 40.8 ceilings bounded locally until Phase 40.10 makes them authoritative Helm/operator configuration.
